senses.en: to know the meaning of something

ex.en: I understand the question now.
ex.zh: 我现在明白这道题了。

ex.en: Planners understand a neighbourhood better when they walk it at the hour children leave school.
ex.zh: 规划者如果在孩子放学的时刻走过一个社区，会理解得更好。

tip: understand 的过去式仍是 understand，不是 understanded。

senses.en: a title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr. Li starts the lesson at eight.
ex.zh: 李老师八点开始上课。

ex.en: A letter that begins with the wrong title, such as Mr. for a woman, can undo an otherwise polite request.
ex.zh: 一封信如果称谓用错，比如对女性用 Mr.，再礼貌的请求也会被削弱。

tip: Mr. 后接姓，不接名。书写时通常作 Mr.。

senses.en: the act of leaving

ex.en: The departure is at four.
ex.zh: 出发时间是四点。

ex.en: The departure time should be on the same sheet as the return time.
ex.zh: 出发时间应当和返回时间写在同一张纸上。

tip: 名词 arrival 已在本库。departure 可数。

senses.en: pleasing, or able to draw interest

ex.en: The poster is attractive, but the time is wrong.
ex.zh: 海报好看，但时间写错了。

ex.en: An attractive fare is useless if the last bus does not stop here.
ex.zh: 如果末班车不在这里停，好看的票价也没用。

tip: attract 已在本库。attractive 不要只用在外貌上。

senses.en: morally good, or belonging to a high social rank
a person of high social rank

ex.en: A noble aim still needs a written time.
ex.zh: 高尚的目标仍然需要一个写下来的时间。

ex.en: The history text uses noble for a rank, not for a compliment.
ex.zh: 历史课文里的 noble 是一种等级，不是一句夸奖。

tip: noble 作名词是贵族。

senses.en: safety, or the people who guard a place

ex.en: The school improved security at the gate.
ex.zh: 学校加强了校门的安保。

ex.en: Food security means a town can still eat when one road is closed by a flood.
ex.zh: 粮食安全意味着一条路被洪水封闭时，城镇仍然吃得上饭。

tip: security 通常不可数。

senses.en: unfair treatment of a person or group

ex.en: Discrimination by race is not a school rule.
ex.zh: 按种族歧视不是校规。

ex.en: A form should not be a tool for discrimination.
ex.zh: 表格不应当成为歧视的工具。

tip: discrimination 通常不可数。说话时要尊重。

senses.en: shared customs and arts
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Food is part of local culture.
ex.zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: an opinion, or what can be seen
to look at, or to consider

ex.en: What is your view on the new timetable?
ex.zh: 你对新课表有什么看法？

ex.en: A fine view of the river does not show whether the water is safe to drink.
ex.zh: 好看的河景并不能说明水是否可以安全饮用。

tip: view 作动词是“观看”或“视为”。

senses.en: to stop living

ex.en: The flowers die if nobody waters them.
ex.zh: 如果没人浇水，花就会死。

ex.en: Fish die in a river long before the colour of the water warns the town.
ex.zh: 鱼会在水色警告城镇之前很久就死在河里。

tip: die 是不及物动词，不能说 die sb。过去式是 died。

senses.en: to win against someone
a loss

ex.en: The team did not defeat anyone; the match was cancelled.
ex.zh: 队伍没有击败任何人，比赛取消了。

ex.en: A defeat on the field should not decide who may use the library.
ex.zh: 场上的失败不应当决定谁可以使用图书馆。

tip: defeat 作名词是失败。比 fail 更常用于比赛或战争。

senses.en: a photograph, a kick or throw at a goal, or an injection

ex.en: She took a shot of the old bridge.
ex.zh: 她给那座旧桥拍了一张照片。

ex.en: A last-minute shot can win a match, but a team still needs a plan for the whole game.
ex.zh: 最后一秒的投篮可以赢得比赛，但球队仍需要整场比赛的计划。

tip: shot 也是 shoot 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: a reason you give to explain a fault
to forgive

ex.en: Tiredness is not an excuse for a locked fire door.
ex.zh: 疲劳不是锁上防火门的借口。

ex.en: Please excuse the delay; the bus was late and the notice said so.
ex.zh: 请原谅这次耽误；公交晚了，通知里也写了。

tip: 名词借口常读 /ɪkˈskjuːs/，动词原谅常读 /ɪkˈskjuːz/。表里给的是动词读音。

senses.en: not thin, or not flowing easily

ex.en: The coat is thick enough for this wind.
ex.zh: 这件外套够厚，能挡这种风。

ex.en: Thick smoke in a hallway is a reason to leave, not to look for a bag.
ex.zh: 走廊里的浓烟是离开的理由，不是找包的理由。

tip: thick 可形容物体、液体或烟雾。

senses.en: acceptable

ex.en: Is it okay if I borrow your ruler?
ex.zh: 我借你的尺子可以吗？

ex.en: An okay-looking timetable still fails students if the last bus leaves before school ends.
ex.zh: 看起来没问题的时刻表，如果末班车在放学前离开，仍然会让学生失望。

tip: okay 与 O.K. 是同一个词。本库只保留 okay。正式写作可用 all right。

senses.en: a disease or a period of being ill

ex.en: The illness kept her at home for three days.
ex.zh: 这场病让她在家待了三天。

ex.en: An illness reported early is easier to treat than one hidden until Friday.
ex.zh: 早报告的病比拖到周五才说的更容易处理。

tip: ill 已在本库。illness 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: younger or lower in rank
Intended for younger people or involving them
A younger person, or a student below the final year

ex.en: He is a junior member of the team.
ex.zh: 他是队里的初级成员。

ex.en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
ex.zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。

tip: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

senses.en: in a true way, or sincerely

ex.en: I am truly sorry for the delay.
ex.zh: 这次耽误我真的很抱歉。

ex.en: A programme is truly open only when students without a laptop can still take part.
ex.zh: 只有没有笔记本电脑的学生也能参加时，一个项目才真正开放。

tip: 信末 Yours truly 是客套结尾。truly 强调真实，不只是程度很高。

senses.en: a flat dish, or a flat piece

ex.en: Put the plate in the sink.
ex.zh: 把盘子放进水槽。

ex.en: A cracked plate in the canteen should be thrown away the same day.
ex.zh: 食堂里裂了的盘子应当当天扔掉。

tip: plate 也可指金属板或车牌。

senses.en: with each other

ex.en: We cleaned the classroom together.
ex.zh: 我们一起打扫了教室。

ex.en: Neighbours who cook together waste less food than families who each buy too much.
ex.zh: 一起做饭的邻居，比各自买得太多的家庭浪费的食物更少。

tip: together 是副词，不单独作动词。

senses.en: the process of making things, or the amount made

ex.en: Food production fell after the dry month.
ex.zh: 干旱的一个月之后，食品产量下降了。

ex.en: Higher production of plastic does not help if the town has nowhere to put the waste.
ex.zh: 如果城镇没有地方放置废物，更高的塑料产量也没有帮助。

tip: production 通常不可数。

senses.en: a place, a job, or an opinion

ex.en: Write your position in the team on the form.
ex.zh: 在表格上写你在队里的位置。

ex.en: A city's position on housing decides who can live near work and who must travel for hours.
ex.zh: 一座城市在住房上的立场，决定谁能住在工作附近，谁必须赶几小时的路。

tip: in a position to do 表示有条件做某事。

senses.en: something you own, or the state of owning it

ex.en: The bag is her possession.
ex.zh: 这个包是她的东西。

ex.en: A list of possessions helps a lost bag return.
ex.zh: 一份物品清单能帮助遗失的包回到主人手里。

tip: possessions 复数常指财物。

senses.en: not in any place

ex.en: The key was nowhere in the lab.
ex.zh: 钥匙在实验室里哪儿都没有。

ex.en: A plan that leads nowhere should be rewritten before the trip.
ex.zh: 哪儿也到不了的计划，应当在出行前改写。

tip: nowhere 已含否定。放在句首时句子常倒装。

senses.en: of the colour of earth or coffee
the colour brown

ex.en: He carried a brown bag.
ex.zh: 他拿着一个棕色的包。

ex.en: Brown flood water in a street is a warning, not a picture to share without context.
ex.zh: 街上的棕色洪水是警报，不是可以不说明背景就转发的照片。

tip: brown 也可作名词表示棕色。

senses.en: of the Olympic Games

ex.en: The Olympic story is on the wall.
ex.zh: 奥林匹克的故事在墙上。

ex.en: An Olympic poster does not replace a field the school can actually use.
ex.zh: 一张奥林匹克海报代替不了学校真正能用的场地。

col: the Olympic Games｜奥林匹克运动会
tip: Olympic 要大写。Olympics 是本批的另一词，指奥运会。

senses.en: to use money or time

ex.en: I spend twenty minutes on new words.
ex.zh: 我花二十分钟学生词。

ex.en: Families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
ex.zh: 物价上涨时，家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。

tip: spend 的主语是人。It takes time 的主语是事物。过去式是 spent。

senses.en: a repeated design, or a regular way something happens

ex.en: The pattern on the cloth is simple.
ex.zh: 布上的图案很简单。

ex.en: A pattern of late buses is a fact, not one unlucky day.
ex.zh: 公交一再晚点是一个事实，不是倒霉的一天。

tip: pattern 可数。作动词是仿造。

senses.en: a substance that flows, like water
in the form of a liquid

ex.en: Do not mix the two liquids.
ex.zh: 不要把这两种液体混在一起。

ex.en: A liquid without a label in the lab should not be used.
ex.zh: 实验室里没有标签的液体不应当使用。

tip: liquid 也可作形容词。本条不写如何混合危险液体。

senses.en: the season between summer and winter; British

ex.en: School starts in autumn.
ex.zh: 学校在秋天开学。

ex.en: An autumn storm still needs the ordinary plan: who calls parents.
ex.zh: 一场秋日暴风雨仍然需要普通的方案：谁给家长打电话。

tip: autumn 是英式。美式秋季常用 fall。本库已有 fall，含义更多。

senses.en: to make it easier for someone to do something
the act of helping

ex.en: Could you help me move this desk?
ex.zh: 你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？

ex.en: Older students can help younger ones settle in, which also builds leadership in the older group.
ex.zh: 高年级学生可以帮助新生适应，这也能培养他们的领导能力。

col: help sb with｜在某方面帮助
with the help of｜在……帮助下
tip: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可以省略。

senses.en: a series of musical notes
to adjust a musical instrument

ex.en: The tune is simple.
ex.zh: 这个曲调很简单。

ex.en: A tune without words still needs a time if the concert has a bus.
ex.zh: 如果音乐会要坐公交，没有歌词的曲子仍然需要一个时间。

tip: tune 作动词是调音。

senses.en: the one belonging to you

ex.en: This seat is yours if you want it.
ex.zh: 如果你要，这个座位是你的。

ex.en: Yours sincerely is a safe ending when you know the name but not the person well.
ex.zh: 知道对方姓名但并不熟时，Yours sincerely 是稳妥的信末用语。

tip: 名词性物主代词，后面不再接名词。your 是限定词，本库未单列。

senses.en: tall, or great in amount or level

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高，我够不着。

ex.en: High housing costs near good schools can shut out the families those schools were meant to serve.
ex.zh: 好学校附近的高房价，可能把学校本应服务的家庭挡在外面。

tip: 人的个子用 tall；山、价格、水平用 high。

senses.en: a person who does office work or keeps records

ex.en: The club secretary wrote the minutes.
ex.zh: 社团秘书写了会议记录。

ex.en: A school secretary often knows which families cannot be reached by phone.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常知道哪些家庭用电话联系不上。

tip: secretary 的复数是 secretaries。

senses.en: to a position on

ex.en: The cat jumped onto the desk.
ex.zh: 猫跳到了书桌上。

ex.en: A ramp onto the platform lets a student with a wheelchair board the same train.
ex.zh: 通向站台的坡道，让坐轮椅的学生能上同一列火车。

tip: onto 强调移动到表面之上。已经在上面用 on。

senses.en: the small part from which a plant grows

ex.en: The seed is in the soil.
ex.zh: 种子在土里。

ex.en: A seed in the school garden needs water in August, when most students are away.
ex.zh: 学校园子里的种子在八月需要水，而那时大多数学生不在。

col: a seed of｜一粒种子；……的萌芽
tip: seed 可数。

senses.en: a date remembered each year

ex.en: The school anniversary is in October.
ex.zh: 校庆在十月。

ex.en: An anniversary speech should name who keeps the building open, not only who founded it.
ex.zh: 周年讲话应当点出是谁让这栋楼一直开着，而不只是谁创办了它。

tip: anniversary 可数。

senses.en: something given to a winner

ex.en: The prize was a book, not money.
ex.zh: 奖品是一本书，不是钱。

ex.en: A prize for attendance can hide the student who was ill and still caught up.
ex.zh: 出勤奖可能掩盖那个生过病却仍然补上进度的学生。

tip: prize 是奖品。award 已在本库，更常指正式授予的奖。

senses.en: how fast something moves

ex.en: The car was travelling at a high speed.
ex.zh: 汽车在高速行驶。

ex.en: Lower speed near a school protects children more than a wider road does.
ex.zh: 学校附近降低速度，比把路修得更宽更能保护孩子。

col: at a speed of｜以……的速度
tip: speed 作动词是“加速”，过去式可以是 sped。

senses.en: a formal public event

ex.en: The ceremony starts at ten.
ex.zh: 典礼十点开始。

ex.en: A ceremony still needs a seat for the parent who comes from work.
ex.zh: 典礼仍然要给下班赶来的家长留一个座位。

tip: ceremony 可数。

senses.en: the usual level or mean
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: His scores are above the average.
ex.zh: 他的分数高于平均水平。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: to put something where it cannot be seen, or to go where you cannot be seen

ex.en: Do not hide the broken step behind a sign.
ex.zh: 不要用一块牌子把坏台阶遮住。

ex.en: Students who hide a worry until the exam give the school no time to help.
ex.zh: 把担心藏到考试的学生，没给学校留下帮忙的时间。

col: hide sth from sb｜对某人隐瞒
tip: hide 的过去式是 hid，过去分词是 hidden。

senses.en: a sound, especially a loud or unpleasant one

ex.en: The noise from the road enters the classroom.
ex.zh: 路上的噪声进了教室。

ex.en: Noise at a school gate is a design problem if the pavement is too narrow.
ex.zh: 如果人行道太窄，校门口的噪声就是设计问题。

tip: noise 可数也可不可数。a noise 是一阵声音。

senses.en: a thin piece of wood
to attach, or to continue with

ex.en: The dog brought back a stick.
ex.zh: 狗把一根棍子叼了回来。

ex.en: A walking stick at the school gate is a tool, not something to joke about.
ex.zh: 校门口的拐杖是工具，不是拿来开玩笑的东西。

tip: 动词 stick 的过去式和过去分词是 stuck。stick to 表示坚持。

senses.en: to decide which one you want

ex.en: Choose a question you can explain.
ex.zh: 选一道你能解释的题。

ex.en: Families choose a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
ex.zh: 家庭选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。

tip: choose 的过去式是 chose，过去分词是 chosen。

senses.en: to remove something written or stored

ex.en: Delete the old time before you write the new one.
ex.zh: 写下新时间之前，先删掉旧时间。

ex.en: Do not delete the only copy of the class list.
ex.zh: 不要删掉班级名单的唯一副本。

tip: delete 比 remove 更常用于文字和文件。

senses.en: in addition to
in addition

ex.en: Besides English, she studies history.
ex.zh: 除了英语，她还学历史。

ex.en: Besides the fare, the later bus matters because students can stay for the club.
ex.zh: 除了票价，晚班车重要是因为学生可以留下参加社团。

tip: besides 表示包括在内的“还有”。except 是排除。作副词是“而且”。

senses.en: a film

ex.en: We saw a movie about a small town.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于小镇的电影。

ex.en: A movie can show a problem, but the town still has to decide what to do on Monday.
ex.zh: 电影可以展示一个问题，但城镇仍要决定星期一做什么。

col: go to the movies｜去看电影
tip: movie 是美式常用词；英式更常说 film。

senses.en: a machine that moves liquid or air
to move liquid or air with a pump

ex.en: The pump is off.
ex.zh: 泵关着。

ex.en: A pump that fails in August leaves the garden dry.
ex.zh: 八月坏掉的泵会让园子变干。

tip: pump 作动词是用泵抽。本条不写危险操作。

senses.en: happening often, or shared

ex.en: Colds are common in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天感冒很常见。

ex.en: A common timetable for buses and schools would stop students waiting in the dark.
ex.zh: 公交和学校共用的时刻表，能避免学生在黑暗中等候。

tip: common 强调经常发生或共有；ordinary 强调平凡、不特别。

senses.en: to divide into parts

ex.en: Split the class into two groups.
ex.zh: 把班级分成两组。

ex.en: Cities that split one bus into two short routes can help students who live past the old stop.
ex.zh: 把一路公交拆成两条短线的城市，能帮助住在旧站以外的学生。

tip: split 的过去式和过去分词仍是 split。

senses.en: to think that something is true

ex.en: I believe we can finish the project tonight.
ex.zh: 我相信我们今晚能做完这个项目。

ex.en: Students should not believe a chart until they know who collected the numbers and why.
ex.zh: 学生在弄清数字是谁收集的、为什么收集之前，不该轻信一张图表。

col: believe it or not｜信不信由你
tip: believe 后接 that 从句或 sb；believe in 表示信任或信仰。

senses.en: a railway vehicle
to teach a skill

ex.en: The train leaves at seven.
ex.zh: 火车七点开。

ex.en: A late train can make a student miss the first lesson even when the school itself starts on time.
ex.zh: 晚点的火车会让学生错过第一节课，即使学校本身准时开始。

tip: train 作动词是“训练”。

senses.en: thin material for writing, or a newspaper

ex.en: Write your name on the paper.
ex.zh: 把名字写在纸上。

ex.en: A paper exam in a hot room measures heat as well as knowledge.
ex.zh: 炎热房间里的纸笔考试，测量的不只是知识，还有热。

tip: paper 表示纸张时不可数。a paper 可以是一份报纸或一篇论文。

senses.en: facing, or completely different
a person or thing that is completely different
across from

ex.en: The shop is opposite the school.
ex.zh: 商店在学校对面。

ex.en: The opposite choice, a later bus, helps the students who stay for sport.
ex.zh: 相反的选择，也就是晚一班车，能帮助留下来运动的学生。

tip: opposite 作介词也可表示在对面。名词是“相反的事物”。

senses.en: large in size or importance

ex.en: We need a bigger table for the group work.
ex.zh: 小组活动我们需要一张更大的桌子。

ex.en: A big sports event can fill hotels while leaving ordinary residents with higher rents.
ex.zh: 一场大型体育赛事可以住满酒店，同时让普通居民面对更高的房租。

tip: big 多用于口语；large 更中性，great 强调程度或情感。

senses.en: not able

ex.en: She was unable to attend the first class.
ex.zh: 她没能上第一节课。

ex.en: A student unable to climb the stairs still needs a way into the lab.
ex.zh: 上不了楼梯的学生，仍然需要一条进实验室的路。

tip: unable 后接 to do。able 已在本库。表里这一行的音标不对，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: the part of the body at the end of the arm
to pass something to someone

ex.en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
ex.zh: 发言前请举手。

ex.en: A helping hand from an older student can matter more than another printed worksheet.
ex.zh: 高年级学生伸来的一只援手，可能比又一张打印的练习纸更重要。

tip: hand in 是上交。hand 作动词是“递”。

senses.en: a period of ten years

ex.en: The school is a decade old.
ex.zh: 这所学校有十年了。

ex.en: A decade of the same broken step is a choice, not an accident.
ex.zh: 同一个坏台阶过了十年，是一种选择，不是意外。

tip: decade 可数。

senses.en: of the sex that can produce young
a female person or animal

ex.en: The form has a box for male or female.
ex.zh: 表格上有男或女的一栏。

ex.en: A female engineer visiting the class shows a possible job, not only a word in a textbook.
ex.zh: 一位女工程师来到班上，展示的是一种可能的工作，而不只是课本里的一个词。

tip: female 可作形容词或名词。填写表格时表示性别。

senses.en: farming

ex.en: Agriculture still feeds the town.
ex.zh: 农业仍然养活这座城镇。

ex.en: A lesson on agriculture should name who does the work.
ex.zh: 农业课应当写出是谁在干活。

tip: 形容词 agricultural 是本批的另一词。agriculture 通常不可数。

senses.en: a large amount, or ordinary people as a group

ex.en: A mass of leaves blocked the drain.
ex.zh: 一大堆叶子堵住了排水口。

ex.en: The masses use the early bus, so a fare rise hits them before it hits anyone with a car.
ex.zh: 普通大众坐早班车，所以票价上涨先打击他们，而不是有车的人。

tip: a mass of 后可接可数或不可数名词。the masses 指广大民众。

senses.en: of the colour of a lemon or the sun
the colour yellow

ex.en: The yellow bus is ours.
ex.zh: 那辆黄色的车是我们的。

ex.en: Yellow lines on the road mean more when students know why they are there.
ex.zh: 当学生知道黄线为什么在那里时，路上的黄线才更有意义。

tip: yellow 也可作名词“黄色”。

senses.en: to form a picture in the mind

ex.en: Imagine a street where children can walk safely.
ex.zh: 想象一条孩子可以安全走路的街。

ex.en: It is hard to imagine a later school start unless the buses change too.
ex.zh: 除非公交也改时间，否则很难想象推迟上学。

tip: imagine 后接名词、doing 或 that 从句。

senses.en: a set of papers or computer data about one subject

ex.en: Please save the file before you close it.
ex.zh: 关闭前请保存文件。

ex.en: A paper file and a computer file of the same student should not disagree.
ex.zh: 同一名学生的纸质档案和电脑档案不应当互相矛盾。

tip: file 也可作动词“把……归档”。计算机里的文档也叫 file。

senses.en: having a lot of money, or full of something

ex.en: The soil here is rich and good for vegetables.
ex.zh: 这里的土壤肥沃，适合种菜。

ex.en: A rich city can still have neighbourhoods where children share one small room.
ex.zh: 富裕的城市里，仍可能有孩子合住一间小屋的社区。

tip: the rich 表示一类人。rich in 后接所富含的东西。

senses.en: the power to change someone or something
to change how someone thinks or acts

ex.en: His teacher had a strong influence on him.
ex.zh: 老师对他影响很大。

ex.en: Peer influence can push a student toward a club or away from one.
ex.zh: 同伴的影响可以把学生推向一个社团，也可以把他们推开。

col: have an influence on｜对……有影响
under the influence of｜在……影响下
tip: influence 后接 on。作动词时直接接宾语：influence somebody。

senses.en: what something is made of, or information for a piece of work

ex.en: The bag is made of recycled material.
ex.zh: 这个包是用回收材料做的。

ex.en: Teaching material about floods should include the streets children actually use.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的教材应该包括孩子真正走的那些街。

tip: material 作“材料”时可数或不可数。作形容词是“物质的”。

senses.en: a student with a class duty, or a screen

ex.en: The monitor locked the lab.
ex.zh: 班长锁了实验室。

ex.en: A monitor on the wall does not replace a person who knows the students.
ex.zh: 墙上的监视器代替不了认识学生的人。

tip: monitor 也可作动词“监视”。班长是中国课堂里的常用义。

senses.en: an idea that someone offers

ex.en: The suggestion is on the board.
ex.zh: 建议写在黑板上。

ex.en: A suggestion about the bus should include the return time.
ex.zh: 关于公交的建议应当包括返回时间。

tip: 动词 suggest 已在本库。suggestion 可数。

senses.en: the child of your aunt or uncle

ex.en: Her cousin will share the book.
ex.zh: 她的表姐会和她合用这本书。

ex.en: A form that says cousin should still leave space for another name.
ex.zh: 写着表亲的表格，仍然应当给另一个名字留出位置。

tip: cousin 可指表兄弟或表姐妹，不标明性别。

senses.en: the reflexive form of we

ex.en: We cleaned the lab ourselves.
ex.zh: 实验室是我们自己打扫的。

ex.en: We cannot blame the timetable if we wrote it ourselves and left out the last bus.
ex.zh: 如果课表是我们自己写的，又漏了末班车，就不能怪课表。

tip: ourselves 是反身代词。by ourselves 表示独自。

senses.en: to say you will give or do something
a proposal to give or pay

ex.en: The library offers a quiet room after school.
ex.zh: 图书馆放学后提供一间安静的房间。

ex.en: Towns that offer night buses help workers who finish after the regular service stops.
ex.zh: 提供夜班公交的城镇，帮助那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人。

tip: offer 后可接 to do 或双宾语。

senses.en: to have one's home, or to be alive
happening now, or alive

ex.en: We live near the old market.
ex.zh: 我们住在旧市场附近。

ex.en: People who live beside a busy road pay a health cost that does not appear on the rent receipt.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路旁的人承担着健康代价，而这不会出现在房租收据上。

tip: live 作动词读 /lɪv/；作形容词“现场的”读 /laɪv/。

senses.en: fitting closely, or firmly fixed

ex.en: The lid is too tight.
ex.zh: 盖子太紧了。

ex.en: A tight budget can still buy the lock if the lab door does not close.
ex.zh: 如果实验室的门关不上，紧的预算也仍然应当先买锁。

tip: tight 可形容衣服、时间或预算。

senses.en: a type
to arrange into groups

ex.en: What sort of book do you want?
ex.zh: 你想要哪一种书？

ex.en: The sort of food sold at the gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
ex.zh: 门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。

tip: sort 作动词是“分类”。

senses.en: a planned piece of work

ex.en: Our project is about the river behind the school.
ex.zh: 我们的课题是关于学校后面的河。

ex.en: A project that never asks local people can solve the wrong problem.
ex.zh: 从不询问当地人的项目，可能会解决一个错误的问题。

tip: project 作名词重音常在前；作动词“投射、预计”时重音常在后。

senses.en: kindness shown when you could punish

ex.en: The story ends with mercy, not with shame.
ex.zh: 故事以怜悯结束，不是以羞辱结束。

ex.en: Mercy for a late form is fair when the bus never came.
ex.zh: 公交根本没来时，原谅迟交的表格是公平的。

tip: mercy 通常不可数。

senses.en: a woman who acts in plays or films

ex.en: The actress visited the drama club.
ex.zh: 这位女演员来了戏剧社。

ex.en: An actress who only reads the lines still needs the crew that built the set.
ex.zh: 只念台词的女演员，仍然需要搭景的那组人。

tip: actor 已在本库，现在也可泛指演员。actress 专指女演员。

senses.en: liked by many people

ex.en: The reading club is popular this term.
ex.zh: 读书社团这学期很受欢迎。

ex.en: A popular beach can damage the very coast people come to see.
ex.zh: 受欢迎的海滩可能破坏人们前来观看的那片海岸。

tip: popular 后接 with 表示受某类人欢迎。

senses.en: to repair, or to decide

ex.en: Can you fix the clock in the hall?
ex.zh: 你能修大厅里的钟吗？

ex.en: Cities should fix the crossing before they fix the paint on the school wall.
ex.zh: 城市应当先修好路口，再去刷学校墙上的漆。

tip: fix 在美式口语里常指修理。确定日期也用 fix。

senses.en: a room for art, music, or broadcasting

ex.en: The art studio is on the top floor.
ex.zh: 美术工作室在顶楼。

ex.en: A studio with one door still needs a window that opens.
ex.zh: 只有一扇门的工作室，仍然需要一扇能开的窗。

tip: studio 可数。复数是 studios。

senses.en: done in a short time

ex.en: We had a quick review before the test.
ex.zh: 测验前我们快速复习了一下。

ex.en: A quick warning is useless if the path to higher ground is not marked.
ex.zh: 如果通往高地的路没有标出，快速的警报也没有用。

tip: quick 的副词是 quickly。fast 本身可作副词。

senses.en: from one side to the other
from one side to the other

ex.en: There is a bookshop across the street.
ex.zh: 街对面有一家书店。

ex.en: A bridge across the river can cut a student's journey from an hour to ten minutes.
ex.zh: 河上的一座桥可以把学生的路程从一小时缩短到十分钟。

tip: across 强调从表面一边到另一边；through 强调从内部穿过。

senses.en: mail, a job, or a pole
to send by mail, or to put up a notice

ex.en: I will send the form by post.
ex.zh: 我会把表格寄出。

ex.en: A post in a village school is hard to fill if the teacher must travel two hours each way.
ex.zh: 如果老师每天要单程走两小时，乡村学校的岗位就很难有人来。

tip: post 作动词是“邮寄”或“张贴”。美式邮件多用 mail。

senses.en: a container of soft material

ex.en: My bag is under the desk.
ex.zh: 我的包在桌子下面。

ex.en: A clear bag rule at the gate should still leave room for a student's medicine.
ex.zh: 门口的透明包规定，仍应当给学生的药留出位置。

tip: bag 可数。a bag of 后接所装的东西。

senses.en: a stick used in some ball games, or a flying animal

ex.en: The bat is in the sports room.
ex.zh: 球棒在体育室。

ex.en: A bat in the school roof is a reason to call an adult, not to chase it.
ex.zh: 屋顶上的蝙蝠是叫成年人的理由，不是去追它。

tip: 球棒和蝙蝠是同一个词。本条不写如何伤害动物。

senses.en: British spelling of organization

ex.en: The organisation runs the late bus.
ex.zh: 这个组织运营晚班车。

ex.en: An organisation that hides its fees is harder for families to trust.
ex.zh: 隐瞒费用的组织更难让家庭信任。

tip: organisation 是英式，organization 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

senses.en: money paid for a service

ex.en: The fee is on the notice.
ex.zh: 费用写在通知上。

ex.en: A fee that is not written down is not a choice a family can make.
ex.zh: 没写下来的费用，不是家庭能够作出的选择。

tip: fee 可数。学费常用复数 fees。

senses.en: to be the right size or kind
healthy, or suitable

ex.en: These shoes do not fit.
ex.zh: 这双鞋不合脚。

ex.en: A school timetable should fit the buses, or students will arrive after the lesson has started.
ex.zh: 课表应该配合公交，否则学生会在课开始后才到。

tip: fit 作形容词是“健康的”或“适合的”。过去式可以是 fitted。

senses.en: usual and expected

ex.en: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.
ex.zh: 考试前紧张是正常的。

ex.en: A normal school day becomes unsafe when the road outside has no pavement.
ex.zh: 当外面的路没有人行道时，普通的上学日会变得不安全。

tip: normal 是形容词；normally 是副词。

senses.en: a game played with a racket and a ball

ex.en: Tennis practice is at four.
ex.zh: 网球训练在四点。

ex.en: A tennis court that locks at dusk leaves the late class outside.
ex.zh: 黄昏就锁上的网球场，把下课晚的班级留在外面。

tip: play tennis 不加 the。

senses.en: a person who takes photographs

ex.en: The photographer asked before taking the picture.
ex.zh: 摄影师拍照前先问过。

ex.en: A photographer at a school event should not post a face without permission.
ex.zh: 学校活动的摄影师不应当未经允许发布人脸。

tip: 名词 photograph 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: to think about carefully
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: Please consider my advice before deciding.
ex.zh: 做决定前请考虑我的建议。

ex.en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
ex.zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。

col: consider all options｜考虑所有选择
be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

senses.en: trust in paying later, a school unit, or praise

ex.en: She got extra credit for the project.
ex.zh: 她因这个课题得到了额外学分。

ex.en: Credit for a cleaner river belongs to the people who stopped the waste, not only to the speech.
ex.zh: 把河变干净的功劳属于制止排污的人，而不只属于那篇讲话。

tip: credit 的几个义要靠搭配区分。

senses.en: connected with a god, or treated with great respect

ex.en: The visit included a sacred place for those who wanted it.
ex.zh: 参观包括一处圣地，给想去的人。

ex.en: A school can explain a sacred object without telling every student to believe.
ex.zh: 学校可以讲解一件圣物，而不要求每个学生去信。

tip: 表里的中文写成了 scared（害怕）。音标是 sacred，本库按“神圣的”写。本条不是劝人信教。

senses.en: a cover for the face
to hide something

ex.en: The mask is by the clinic door.
ex.zh: 口罩在医务室门边。

ex.en: A mask in a health lesson is a tool, and the lesson should say when to change it.
ex.zh: 健康课里的口罩是工具，课上应当说明何时更换。

tip: mask 作动词是掩饰。本条不写如何伤害。

senses.en: to succeed, hand over, or go by
a permit, or a successful result

ex.en: I hope to pass the listening test.
ex.zh: 我希望通过听力测验。

ex.en: Students who pass a crowded junction every morning need a light, not only a higher test score.
ex.zh: 每天早晨经过拥挤路口的学生需要一盏灯，而不只是更高的考分。

tip: pass 的过去式是 passed。past 是介词或名词，不要拼混。

senses.en: belonging to a king or queen

ex.en: The royal garden is open on Sunday.
ex.zh: 皇家花园周日开放。

ex.en: A royal visit fills the news, while the town's ordinary market still has to open on Monday.
ex.zh: 王室来访会占满新闻，而镇上的普通集市周一仍然得开。

tip: royal 是形容词。国王或女王用 king、queen。
